title: Cancel a NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card
summary: You can cancel your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card online, or by calling 13 77 88 or visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you wish to cancel your NSW Seniors Card or NSW Senior Savers Card, you can do this online. If you're unable to cancel your card online, call us on 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

If you have a Gold Opal Card, it will be cancelled at the same time as your Seniors Card.

Note: You can also convert your Senior Savers Card to a Seniors Card.
what_you_need: The service 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' added to your MyServiceNSW Account (if you have not already)
Your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card number
If cancelling by phone or at a service centre: Your personal details and your Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card number

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to cancel your card.

faqs.q: What happens to my Gold Opal Card if I cancel my Seniors Card?
faqs.a: If you have a Gold Opal Card, it will be cancelled at the same time as your Seniors Card.

faqs.q: How can I cancel my card if I cannot do it online?
faqs.a: You can call 13 77 88 or visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Can I convert my Senior Savers Card to a Seniors Card?
faqs.a: Yes, you can also convert your Senior Savers Card to a Seniors Card.
